title: Packet Guides
description: Technical tutorials and foundational architecture references on Star Wars Galaxies networking, SOE protocol, encryption, CRC checksums, and packet reversing.

guides.title: Binary & Hex
guides.summary: Essential foundation in bits, bytes, endianness, signed vs unsigned integer representations, and hexadecimal notation for packet analysis.

guides.title: SWG Packet Introduction
guides.summary: Foundational introduction to the SWG network packet architecture, packet wrapping, and UDP encapsulation hierarchy.

guides.title: SOE Protocol Breakdown
guides.summary: Comprehensive specification of the SOE UDP protocol layer, operational channels (0x00 to 0x1E), ACKs, multi-packet, and sequencing.

guides.title: SWG Packet Encryption
guides.summary: Mechanics of the SOE XOR mask stream cipher, key derivation from the CRC seed, and decryption implementation in C++.

guides.title: SWG Packet CRC
guides.summary: Cyclic Redundancy Check (CRC32) algorithm, polynomial table generation, seed initialization, and checksum verification routines.

guides.title: SWG Packet Compression
guides.summary: Zlib compression rules, payload compression flags (0x01), byte-length thresholds, and decompression pipeline.

guides.title: SWG Packet Footer
guides.summary: Structure of the trailing packet footer, 2-byte CRC calculation, and encryption/compression flag byte positions.

guides.title: SWG Packets
guides.summary: Format and structure of game-level packets encapsulated within SOE Channel 0, including operand counts and opcode dispatch.

guides.title: Reversing Structs
guides.summary: Step-by-step methodology for analyzing unknown packet byte streams, identifying datatypes, and reconstructing struct definitions.

guides.title: PSWGCommon: arquitetura e guia de leitura
guides.summary: Arquitetura, dependências, fluxos e limites da investigação.

guides.title: PSWGCommon: codecs, pacotes e replicação
guides.summary: Codecs, endian, framing, factories, baseline, delta e controllers.

guides.title: PSWGCommon: dados, serialização e persistência
guides.summary: Modelos, CRC, customização, OOB, SUI e persistência Mongo.

guides.title: PSWGCommon: arquivos do cliente e terreno
guides.summary: As duas APIs IFF, formatos, caches e motor de terreno.

guides.title: PSWGCommon: evidências REA e Binary Ninja
guides.summary: Evidências do Binary Ninja e limitações do provedor REA.

guides.title: PSWGCommon: três mensagens comparadas com o cliente
guides.summary: Contenção, criação de objetos e chat confrontados com leitores e escritores do cliente.

guides.title: PSWGCommon: catálogo lexical das fontes
guides.summary: Inventário completo de arquivos e cruzamento nominal de mensagens.

guides.title: Holocore: arquitetura e mapa funcional
guides.summary: Mapa funcional, estrutura do repositório, inicialização e limites.

guides.title: Holocore: fluxos de execução
guides.summary: Fluxos de inicialização, login, zone-in, awareness, rede e persistência.

guides.title: Holocore: transporte de rede e fluxo de pacotes
guides.summary: Transporte TCP/WebSocket, handshake, CRC e comparação estática com Binary Ninja.

guides.title: Holocore: serviços, intents e gameplay
guides.summary: Managers, intents, gameplay, objetos, login, chat e persistência.

guides.title: Holocore: conversão de dados do cliente
guides.summary: Conversores de clientdata, arquivos SDB/IFF e loaders runtime.
